statement: Pinned xwiishow opens the MotionPlus evdev interface and converts EV_ABS ABS_RX/RY/RZ into XWII_EVENT_MOTION_PLUS; the library subtracts configurable per-axis zero offsets and optionally adjusts them with a gradual convergence factor. xwiishow supplies an interactive zeroing action; it does not implement raw MotionPlus I2C register decoding or read the MotionPlus calibration EEPROM itself. Opening that evdev FD invokes hid-wiimote's MP_USED activation under an attached kernel device.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer; xwiimote 4df713d; core.c 1040-1094,1944-1969; xwiishow.c 662-768. No physical calibration proof or measured runtime.
